propositions: GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name fields only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup
The session-start readiness gate waited for Epic fields before any project existed, creating an ordering deadlock where the gate blocked the action required to provision those fields
Discriminating experiment proved the deadlock: Epic fields remained absent after 180 seconds of quiet waiting time but appeared 0.05 seconds after project creation
The fix relocates the Epic-field readiness check from session start to post-project-creation in _assert_project_capabilities, where the capability can actually exist
The budget parameter is rewritten from 600s to 120s with documented measurement constant, and poll cadence increased from 10s to 1s to match the sub-second registration time
Harness run 30982731669 achieved 62 passed cells with 0 failed and 0 errored after the fix, verifying the ordering hypothesis and eliminating budget-exhaustion and image-degradation alternatives
